data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Must be ≥18 to ≤70 years of age at the time of signing the ICF.

data.name: Established diagnosis of UC
data.text: Have had an established diagnosis of UC for ≥3 months before baseline (Visit 2/randomization), which includes endoscopic evidence of UC and a histopathology report that supports a diagnosis of UC.

data.name: Moderately to severely active UC
data.text: Have moderately to severely active UC as defined by an mMS of 5 to 9 points and ES of 2 to 3 (confirmed by central review) within 21 days before baseline. Notes: Participants with proctitis at baseline (Visit 2) may participate in the study if they meet all the eligibility criteria for the study, including endoscopic and rectal bleeding criteria for moderate-to-severe disease. The number of such participants will be capped at 15% of the total number of participants enrolled in the study.

data.name: Colorectal cancer surveillance
data.text: Are up-to date on colorectal cancer surveillance per local guidelines in case of a family history of colorectal cancer, personal history of increased colorectal cancer risk, age >45 years, history of UC for greater than or equal to 8 years or other known risk factors.

data.name: Surveillance colonoscopy negative results
data.text: Participants with a history of UC for greater than or equal to 8 years who have had a surveillance colonoscopy completed within 1 year prior to baseline must have documented negative results for colorectal dysplasia and cancer. Note: Acceptable methods of colonoscopic surveillance include standard-definition colonoscopy with 4 quadrant colon biopsies every 10 cm, high-definition white-light colonoscopy with narrow-band imaging and targeted colon biopsies, and chromoendoscopy with methylene blue or indigo carmine dye spray and targeted colon biopsies. Investigators may perform surveillance colonoscopy as part of the screening colonoscopy if they choose to do so.

data.name: Willingness to consult dietitian
data.text: Are willing to consult with a dietitian or nutritionist, or equivalent qualified designee or delegate* according to local standards, to receive lifestyle management counseling during trial. (*Dietary counseling will be performed by a registered dietitian or nutritionist or equivalent qualified designee or delegate trained in collecting and assessing dietary intake and providing individualized dietary counseling according to the local standard).

data.name: Weight/BMI requirement
data.text: Have [7a] obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m2), or [7b] overweight (BMI ≥27 kg/m2 to <30 kg/m2) and in the presence of at least 1 of these weight-related comorbid conditions: hypertension, T2DM, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, or cardiovascular disease.

data.name: Sex and contraceptive requirements
data.text: Individuals AMAB and AFAB may participate in this trial, including both IOCBP and INOCBP. Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. For the contraception requirements of this protocol, see Section 10.4.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Section 10.1, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Prior medication failure
data.text: Have an inadequate response to, loss of response to, or intolerance to at least 1 of the medications described in inclusion criterion [10a] or [10b]. Documentation of dose, frequency, route of administration, and duration of the prior failed treatment is required or could be reported by the participant. [10a] Conventional-failed participants: Participants who have had an inadequate response to or a loss of response to, or are intolerant to at least 1 of the following medications: oral corticosteroids, oral AZA or 6-MP, or oral aminosalicylates (for example, mesalamine, sulfasalazine, olsalazine, and balsalazide) AND have neither failed nor demonstrated an intolerance to an advanced therapy indicated for the treatment of UC, for example, a biologic or biosimilar medication, such as anti-TNF, anti-integrin antibody, or a JAK inhibitor. [10b] Advanced therapy-failed participants: Participants who have an inadequate response to or a loss of response to, or are intolerant to advanced therapy for UC, defined as: a biologic or biosimilar medication such as anti-TNF antibodies, anti-integrin antibodies, JAK inhibitors such as tofacitinib or upadacitinib, sphingosine 1-phosphate receptor 1 inhibitors such as etrasimod or ozanimod, or anti-IL-12p40 antibodies, for example, ustekinumab. Investigators must be able to document an adequate clinical trial of the medication if available or could be provided by patient reported history. Notes: Participants previously exposed to advanced therapy who do not meet criterion [10b] must still meet criterion [10a]. Participants previously exposed to investigational therapies for the treatment of UC must still meet criterion [10a] OR [10b]. Participants who meet both criteria [10a] and [10b] will be considered to be 'advanced therapy-failed' for the purpose of this study. Oral methotrexate use will be allowed during the study; however, prior or current use of oral methotrexate is insufficient for inclusion into the study.

data.name: Stable UC medication dose
data.text: Are on a stable dose, defined as listed here, if using these medications: Oral 5-ASAs for UC - the prescribed dose has been stable for at least 2 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy. Oral corticosteroids for UC (prednisone ≤20 mg per day or equivalent, budesonide extended-release tablets up to 9 mg per day (budesonide MMX), or beclomethasone dipropionate (gastro-resistant prolonged-release tablet) up to 5 mg per day) - participants on oral corticosteroids need to have been on corticosteroids for at least 4 weeks prior to screening but the prescribed dose must be stable for at least 2 weeks before the screening colonoscopy. AZA, 6-MP, or methotrexate - the prescribed dose has been stable for at least 8 weeks before the screening colonoscopy.

data.name: Acceptable laboratory test results
data.text: Have clinically acceptable central laboratory test results at screening (retesting is allowed for hematology and chemistry), as assessed by the investigator, including: [12a] Hematology: absolute neutrophil count ≥1.2 x 109/L (≥1.2 x 103/μL or ≥1.2 GI/L), platelet count ≥100 x 109/L (≥100 x 103/μL or ≥100 GI/L), hemoglobin ≥8.5 g/dL (≥85 g/L) for individuals AMAB and >8.0 g/dL (>80 g/L) for individuals AFAB, lymphocyte count ≥750 cells/μL (>0.75 x 103/μL or >0.75 GI/L), total WBC ≥2.5 x 109/L (≥2.5 x 103/μL or ≥2.5 GI/L). [12b] Chemistry: serum creatinine ≤2 times ULN, TBL ≤1.5 times ULN, ALT and AST ≤2 times ULN, ALP ≤1.5 times ULN. [12c] estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m2 calculated by Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) Cystatin C Equation 2012 (NKF). [12d] calcitonin ≤35 ng/L (≤35 pg/mL). Note: Participants with an established diagnosis of Gilbert's syndrome can be included with bilirubin levels ≤3 times ULN. The Gilbert's syndrome diagnosis requires source documentation showing unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia with no evidence of hemolysis.

data.name: Reliability and willingness to comply
data.text: Are reliable and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and are willing to follow study procedures as required, including, but not limited to colonoscopies, self-injecting intervention or injection by a caregiver, when applicable, maintaining a diary, completing patient-reported questionnaires, and storing and taking provided study interventions as directed.

data.name: Current diagnosis of Crohn's disease, IBD unclassified, or PSC
data.text: Have a current diagnosis of Crohn's disease, IBD unclassified (formerly known as indeterminate colitis), or primary sclerosing cholangitis.

data.name: Bowel resection or intra-abdominal surgery
data.text: Have had or will need bowel resection or intestinal or intra-abdominal surgery, including but not limited to extensive colonic surgery for UC, for example, subtotal colectomy, ostomy, or ileoanal pouch; any small bowel or colonic surgery within 6 months prior to baseline (Visit 2); or any non-intestinal intra-abdominal surgery within 3 months of baseline.

data.name: Likely to require surgery for UC
data.text: Are likely to require surgery for the treatment of UC during the study. Note: Participants who have had limited surgery for UC, for example, segmental colonic resection, may be allowed in the study, if this does not affect the assessment of efficacy. Discussion with the sponsor should occur prior to screening of such participants.

data.name: Toxic megacolon or colonic stricture/stenosis
data.text: Have evidence of toxic megacolon or stricture or stenosis within the colon that cannot be traversed by a sigmoidoscope or colonoscope.

data.name: History or current GI tract cancer
data.text: Have any history or current evidence of cancer of the GI tract.

data.name: Prior or current GI dysplasia
data.text: Have had prior or current GI dysplasia, other than a completely removed low-grade dysplastic lesion, before the screening endoscopy.

data.name: Unremoved adenomatous polyp without dysplasia
data.text: Have any adenomatous polyp without dysplasia occurring in areas of the colon and rectum, that has not been removed. Note: If the polyp(s) has been completely removed, this criterion would no longer apply.

data.name: Cancer or dysplasia diagnosis at screening or during study
data.text: Have a diagnosis of any of the following at screening or during the study: cancer other than squamous cell or basal cell carcinoma of the skin (for details, see exclusion criterion [32]); any colonic adenomatous polyp with low-grade dysplasia not completely removed; any adenomatous polyp with high-grade dysplasia; or evidence of dysplasia in nonpolypoid mucosa (indefinite for dysplasia, low-grade or high-grade dysplasia) in the GI tract.

data.name: Diagnosis of T1DM or insulin-treated T2DM
data.text: Have a diagnosis of T1DM or insulin-treated T2DM.

data.name: Proliferative or nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy requiring treatment
data.text: Have any current or past history, or a diagnosis of proliferative diabetic retinopathy, diabetic maculopathy, or nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy that requires acute treatment.

data.name: History of severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have a history of severe hypoglycemia and/or hypoglycemia unawareness within the 6 months prior to Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: History of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state or coma
data.text: Have a history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state or coma in the last year.

data.name: Significant recent body weight change
data.text: Have a self-reported change in body weight greater than 5% (gain or reduction) within 3 months prior to Visit 1.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity, such as gastric bypass (bariatric) surgery or restrictive bariatric surgery (for example, Lap-Band®), excluding liposuction or abdominoplasty if performed more than 1 year prior to Visit 1.

data.name: Clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality
data.text: Have a known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality (for example, severe gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction).

data.name: Family or personal history of MTC or MEN syndrome type 2
data.text: Have a family or personal history of medullary thyroid cancer (MTC) or multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN) syndrome type 2.

data.name: History of chronic or acute pancreatitis
data.text: Have a current or past history of chronic or acute pancreatitis.

data.name: Acute or chronic hepatitis or other liver disease
data.text: Have acute or chronic hepatitis, or signs and symptoms of any other liver disease other than nonalcoholic fatty liver disease.

data.name: History of malignant disease within 5 years
data.text: Have a diagnosis or history of malignant disease within 5 years prior to baseline (Visit 2). Exceptions: basal cell or squamous epithelial carcinomas of the skin that have been resected with no evidence of metastatic disease for 3 years, and cervical carcinoma in situ that has been resected with no evidence of recurrence for at least 5 years prior to baseline (Visit 2).

data.name: Significant uncontrolled illness
data.text: Have a significant uncontrolled illness that in the opinion of the investigator may compromise the participant's safety or interfere with interpretation of data; such illnesses or conditions include, but are not limited to cerebrocardiovascular (for example, myocardial infarction, unstable angina, unstable arterial hypertension, moderate-to-severe (New York Heart Association class III/IV) heart failure, or cerebrovascular accident), respiratory, hepatic, renal, GI (excluding UC), endocrine, hematologic or lymphoproliferative, neurologic, serious infection, awaiting or having a history of organ transplant (except keratoplasty), or evidence of active vasculitis or uveitis.

data.name: History of unstable MDD, suicidal ideation, or severe psychiatric disorder
data.text: Have a history of unstable major depressive disorder (MDD), suicidal ideation, or other severe psychiatric disorder (for example, schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or other serious mood or anxiety disorder) within the last 2 years. Note: Participants with MDD or generalized anxiety disorder whose disease state is considered stable for the past 2 years and expected to remain stable throughout the course of the study, in the opinion of the investigator, may be considered for inclusion.

data.name: History of chronic alcohol or drug abuse
data.text: Have a history of chronic alcohol abuse, IV drug abuse, or other illicit drug abuse within 1 year before screening colonoscopy.

data.name: Actively suicidal
data.text: Are, in the judgment of the investigator, actively suicidal and therefore deemed to be at significant risk for suicide.

data.name: C-SSRS suicidal ideation or behavior
data.text: Have answered "yes" to either Question 4 or Question 5 on the "Suicidal Ideation" portion of the C-SSRS and the ideation occurred within the past month. OR Have answered "yes" to any of the suicide-related behaviors on the "suicidal behavior" portion of the C-SSRS and the behavior occurred within the past month.

data.name: Incomplete recovery from extra-abdominal surgery
data.text: Have had extra-abdominal surgery and have not recovered fully following surgery, including complete wound healing, before screening.

data.name: Known allergy or hypersensitivity to study interventions
data.text: Have a known or suspected allergy or hypersensitivity to mirikizumab or tirzepatide, any of their excipients, or any other GLP-1 receptor agonists or excipients, that would pose an unacceptable risk to the participant in this study; clinically significant multiple or severe drug allergies; or a history of severe post-treatment hypersensitivity reactions, including, but not limited to, erythema multiforme major, linear IgA dermatosis, toxic epidermal necrolysis, or exfoliative dermatitis.

data.name: Current or recent acute active infection
data.text: Have a current or recent acute, active infection. For at least 30 days before screening (Visit 1) and up to the randomization visit (Visit 2), participants must have no symptoms or signs of confirmed or suspected infection, and must have completed any appropriate anti-infective treatment. Note: Participants who have an upper respiratory infection, a vaginal candida infection, or an oral candida infection and who are being treated only symptomatically and not requiring systemic anti-infectives may be considered for enrollment if other study eligibility criteria are met. Enrollment of participants with other uncomplicated local infections should be discussed with the sponsor's designated medical monitor.

data.name: Serious, opportunistic, chronic, or recurring extraintestinal infections
data.text: Have had any of the following types of infection, including chronic or recurring extraintestinal infections, within 3 months prior to the screening visit (Visit 1) or develops any of these infections before the randomization visit (Visit 2): Serious (requiring hospitalization, or IV or equivalent oral antibiotic treatment, or both); Opportunistic (as defined in Winthrop et al. 2015) - Note: Herpes zoster is considered active and ongoing until all vesicles are dry and crusted over; Chronic (duration of symptoms, signs, and/or treatment of 6 weeks or longer); Recurring (including, but not limited to, herpes simplex, herpes zoster, recurring cellulitis, and chronic osteomyelitis). Note: Participants with only recurrent mild and uncomplicated orolabial herpes, or genital herpes, or both may be discussed with the sponsor's designated medical monitor and considered for enrollment if other study eligibility criteria are met.

data.name: Nonserious extraintestinal infection not adequately treated
data.text: Have a nonserious extraintestinal infection that is not adequately treated prior to screening and randomization. Note: A participant who develops an extraintestinal infection during the screening period must be adequately treated before receiving study intervention.

data.name: Active TB or untreated LTBI
data.text: Have active TB or untreated LTBI. [43a] Have active TB (Section 8.2.10). [43b] Have had LTBI that has not been treated with a complete course of appropriate therapy as defined by the WHO and the United States CDC, unless such treatment is underway (Section 8.2.10). Note: Participants diagnosed with LTBI at screening may be allowed to re-screen for the study, provided they fulfil the criteria described in Section 8.2.10. Participants who have a documented history of completing an appropriate TB prophylaxis regimen with no history of risk of re-exposure since their treatments were completed and no evidence of active TB are eligible to participate in the study.

data.name: HIV infection
data.text: Have HIV infection.

data.name: Current HBV infection
data.text: Have a current infection with HBV; that is, positive for HBsAg and/or PCR positive for HBV DNA (Section 8.2.11).

data.name: Current HCV infection
data.text: Have a current infection with HCV; that is, positive for HCV RNA (Section 8.2.12).

data.name: Known active COVID-19 infection
data.text: Have a known active COVID-19 infection. If a participant has signs/symptoms suggestive of COVID-19, they should undergo molecular (for example, PCR) testing to rule out SARS-CoV-2 infection. Participants who do not meet COVID-19 eligibility criteria must be screen failed and may only rescreen after they meet the following COVID-19 criteria: Symptomatic participants: At least 14 days have passed since recovery, defined as resolution of fever without use of antipyretics and improvement in symptoms; Asymptomatic participants: At least 14 days have passed since the first positive molecular (for example, PCR) test result.

data.name: C. difficile or other intestinal infection
data.text: Have C. difficile or other intestinal infection within 30 days of screening colonoscopy or test positive at screening for C. difficile or for other intestinal pathogens.

data.name: Confirmed cytomegalovirus-associated colitis
data.text: Have a confirmed diagnosis of cytomegalovirus-associated colitis. Note: Participants may be eligible if they have had adequate treatment of this condition and have resolution of symptoms at least 3 months prior to screening colonoscopy, provided all other study eligibility criteria are met.

data.name: Prior UC treatments within specified washout periods
data.text: Have received any of the following for the treatment of UC within the timeframes listed: Rectally administered topical therapies (corticosteroid or 5-ASA enemas, suppositories, or foam applications) within 2 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy; IV corticosteroids within 2 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy and throughout screening (participants requiring systemic corticosteroids for non-UC conditions, except corticosteroids to treat adrenal insufficiency, are excluded); Immunomodulatory medications including oral cyclosporine, IV cyclosporine, mycophenolate mofetil, thalidomide, JAK inhibitors (tofacitinib, baricitinib, upadacitinib, filgotinib), tacrolimus within 2 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy (AZA, 6-MP, and methotrexate are allowed; topical tacrolimus for non-UC conditions is allowed); Budesonide standard formulation within 2 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy (oral budesonide extended-release tablet formulation (budesonide MMX) is allowed); Leukocyte apheresis (leukapheresis, for example, Adacolumn®) within 3 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy; Any investigational nonbiologic therapy within 4 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy or within 5 half-lives prior to the screening colonoscopy, whichever is longer; Infliximab or infliximab biosimilars within 7 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy (exclusion does not apply if undetectable drug level is demonstrated); Adalimumab or adalimumab biosimilars within 10 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy (exclusion does not apply if undetectable drug level is demonstrated); Golimumab or golimumab biosimilars within 10 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy (exclusion does not apply if undetectable drug level is demonstrated); Any investigational biologic therapy not otherwise mentioned within 8 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy or 5 half-lives prior to the screening colonoscopy, whichever is longer; Interferon therapy within 8 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy; S1P receptor agonist (ozanimod or etrasimod) within 8 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy; Anti-integrin antibodies (vedolizumab, approved biosimilars) within 12 weeks prior to the screening colonoscopy (exclusion does not apply if undetectable drug level is demonstrated); Agents that deplete B or T cells (rituximab, alemtuzumab, visilizumab, approved biosimilars) within 12 months prior to the screening colonoscopy (excluded if evidence of persistent targeted lymphocyte depletion at time of screening colonoscopy); Anti-IL-23p19 antibodies (mirikizumab, risankizumab, brazikumab, guselkumab, tildrakizumab, approved biosimilars) at any time prior to screening (only individuals who have never received these medications can be enrolled); Anti-IL-12p40 antibodies (ustekinumab or ustekinumab biosimilars) within 16 weeks prior to screening colonoscopy (exclusion does not apply if undetectable drug level is demonstrated).

data.name: Failure of 4 or more classes of advanced therapies
data.text: Have failed 4 or more classes of advanced therapies approved for the treatment of UC.

data.name: Prohibited medications within required washout periods
data.text: Have received any of the medications within the required washout period described in this table: Antihyperglycemic medications (sulfonylurea medications, amylin mimetics, DPP-4 inhibitors, glinides, and/or insulin) within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is longer, prior to Visit 2 (Note: antihyperglycemic medications for the management of T2DM are permitted, for example, metformin, thiazolidinediones, and SGLT2 inhibitors); Medications that may promote weight loss (GLP-1 receptor agonists, GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists, orlistat, sibutramine, phenylpropanolamine, mazindol, phentermine, lorcaserin, phendimetrazine, phentermine/topiramate combination, naltrexone/bupropion, or oral superabsorbent hydrogel) within 3 months prior to Visit 2; Medications that may cause significant weight gain (tricyclic antidepressants, atypical antipsychotics, and mood stabilizers, examples: imipramine, mirtazapine, paroxetine, phenelzine, chlorpromazine, thioridazine, clozapine, olanzapine, valproic acid (and its derivatives), or lithium) within 3 months prior to Visit 2 (exceptions: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors other than paroxetine are permitted; amitriptyline is permitted, as a medication commonly prescribed in IBD); Live attenuated vaccination(s), including BCG, within 4 weeks before Visit 2 (participants should be excluded if they intend to receive any vaccination during the study or within 3 months after receiving the last dose of study intervention; RNA vaccines, vaccines with inactive viral elements, and/or nonreplicating viral vector vaccines are not considered live vaccines).

data.name: Previous failure or intolerance to GLP-1 receptor agonists or tirzepatide
data.text: Have a previous failure or intolerance to GLP-1 receptor agonists or tirzepatide.

data.name: Currently enrolled in another clinical study
data.text: Are currently enrolled in any other clinical study involving an investigational product or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study.

data.name: Previously completed or discontinued from this or related study
data.text: Have previously completed or discontinued from this study or any other study investigating mirikizumab or tirzepatide. This criterion does not apply to patients undergoing rescreening procedures.

data.name: Lilly employees or employees of third-party organizations
data.text: Are Lilly employees or employees of third-party organizations involved with the study.

data.name: Investigator site personnel or immediate family
data.text: Are investigator site personnel directly affiliated with this study and/or their immediate families. Immediate family is defined as a spouse, parent, child, or sibling, whether biological or legally adopted.

data.name: Unwilling or unable to comply with data collection device or study procedures
data.text: Are unwilling or unable to comply with the use of a data collection device to directly record data from the participant daily for the duration of this study or are unable to complete other study procedures.

data.name: Unsuitable for inclusion per investigator or sponsor judgment
data.text: Are unsuitable for inclusion in the study in the opinion of the investigator or sponsor for any reason that may compromise the participant's safety or confound data interpretation.

data.name: Pregnant, intending to become pregnant, or breastfeeding
data.text: Are pregnant, or intend to become pregnant or to breastfeed during the study or within 10 weeks after receiving the last dose of the study intervention.

data.name: Abnormal 12-lead ECG
data.text: Have abnormal 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) that, in the opinion of the investigator or sponsor, increases the risks associated with participating in the study.
